name: decision-pack
title: Innovation decision pack
for_each: select id,name from campaigns order by name

sections.title: Ideas and evidence coverage
sections.sql: select s.name,s.stage,s.covered,s.criteria,s.complete_reviewers,s.weighted_score from idea_scores s join ideas i on i.id=s.id where i.campaign_id=$1 order by s.name

sections.title: Decision record
sections.sql: select i.name,d.actor,d.reason,d.from_stage,d.to_stage,d.created_at from decisions d join ideas i on i.id=d.idea_id where i.campaign_id=$1 order by d.created_at

name: pilot-report
title: Pilot result record
for_each: select id,name from pilots order by name

sections.title: Approved commitment
sections.sql: select p.cost,c.currency,p.approved_by from pilots p join ideas i on i.id=p.idea_id join campaigns c on c.id=i.campaign_id where p.id=$1

name: outcome-statement
title: Measured outcome statement
for_each: select id,name from campaigns order by name

sections.title: Measured periods
sections.sql: select i.name,o.name outcome,o.period_start,o.period_end,o.amount,c.currency,o.evidence,o.recorded_by,o.verified_by from outcomes o join ideas i on i.id=o.idea_id join campaigns c on c.id=i.campaign_id where c.id=$1 order by o.period_start

sections.title: Verified totals
sections.sql: select name,currency,verified_outcomes from campaign_summary where id=$1
